text:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY ALERT] Promotion blocked for release/2025-03-23. reason=manifest-image != prod-image for service: inference-api. Action: HOLD promotion. manifest image=ghcr.io/redwood/inference:v1.4.0, prod-deployed image=ghcr.io/redwood/inference:v1.3.9

alex: saw this, we just ran staging promote earlier — did the image get re-tagged after the pipeline?

kara: staging and prod image tags should match. possible CI re-tag or forced push. @deploy-bot can you show the commit sha for both?

deploy-bot: commit mismatch: manifest sha=abc1234, prod sha=def5678. related PR=#4827. auto-canary failed health check at 2/3 replicas.

raj: checking config parity — could be feature flags or a secret mismatch causing the new image to fail health probes. running quick diff now:
```kubectl get cm feature-config -n prod -o yaml | sed -n '1,80p'
kubectl get cm feature-config -n staging -o yaml | sed -n '1,80p'
```

tina: quick diff: FEATURE_X_ENABLED=true in staging, false in prod. also prod has an older env REDWOOD_API_TOKEN that wasn't rotated.

morgan: that token rotation explains failed canary readiness (auth to upstream). looks like new image expects rotated token. propose rollback to ghcr.io/redwood/inference:v1.3.7 and pin image in pipeline until we fix rotation flow. @infra-oncall can you approve rollback outside change window?

infra-oncall: approve — severity: service-degradation risk. proceed with safe rollback and scale down canaries.

morgan: executing rollback and pin now:
```kubectl set image deploy/inference-api inference-api=ghcr.io/redwood/inference:v1.3.7 -n prod
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-api -n prod
```

morgan: rollout completed, 3/3 replicas ready, watching metrics and logs :eyes: 

alex: verified traffic and latency back to baseline. adding a pin in the release pipeline to prevent automatic tag mutation (temporary). also adding a short note to release notes: "Promotion held due to image/secret mismatch; rolled back to v1.3.7."

kara: next steps: create postmortem, update runbook to include a pre-promote env parity check and secret rotation verification. I'll own the runbook update. @tina please open a ticket to rotate REDWOOD_API_TOKEN for prod via KMS and document the rotation hook.

tina: opened INF-989 with steps + impact assessment + rollback playbook attached. assigned to platform and security.

raj: follow-up task: run an env-parity scan across services tomorrow and add a CI gate to fail promotion if critical env keys differ.

morgan: +1. we'll also tweak deploy-bot to emit a clearer failure message when manifest vs prod differ and include the exact diff in the alert.

alex: thanks everyone — great quick coordination. closing this thread after postmortem and runbook updates. :white_check_mark:
